review_scope: All 36 lines read. Permission and gated-feature includes unresolved; product variables and observed dataset completeness remain unverified. No adoption or measured effectiveness certificate.

claims.statement: The metrics overview describes organization and cross-organization enterprise views; target scope and access filters must be retained when interpreting data.
The overview permits viewing the full dataset or filtering by criteria; a filtered view cannot be substituted for exhaustive estate coverage.
The summary reports pushes containing secrets that were blocked, not every attempted secret exposure or all possible ingress paths.
The summary separately reports bypass counts; bypass activity is not successful remediation or absence of risk.
The overview identifies secret types most often blocked or bypassed; frequency does not establish detection recall for other types.
The overview ranks repositories by blocked-push activity; no activity is not proof of effective protection or clean content.
The overview ranks repositories by bypass activity, a distinct dimension from block counts.
Bypass-reason distribution reflects reasons supplied by users, not independent verification that values were tests or false positives.
Repository administration is listed as a route to metrics visibility; visibility is not enforcement authority or coverage proof.
A custom repository role with view-secret-scanning-alerts permission is listed as another visibility route; an arbitrary custom role is not equivalent.
Repository alert access is also listed for metrics visibility; permission-limited omissions must remain explicit, not be interpreted as zero events.
